name: Liam Baker
bio:
Liam's fascination with motorsport ignited during his childhood in Auckland, where he spent countless hours tinkering with go-karts. This early passion led him to pursue a degree in Electrical Engineering, specializing in advanced control systems. His dedication quickly caught the attention of local racing teams, giving him invaluable hands-on experience in data acquisition and analysis. 

At Elite Motorsport, Liam is known for his meticulous approach to problem-solving and his ability to quickly adapt to high-pressure situations. He excels at optimizing electronic systems for peak performance, always striving to find that extra edge through innovative solutions. His ambition is not just to improve lap times but to advance the entire team's understanding of vehicle dynamics through his insightful analysis and system integrations.

Liam is particularly adept at diagnosing and resolving complex electrical issues, often identifying subtle anomalies that others might miss. He firmly believes that the key to success lies in continuous learning and collaboration, always eager to share his knowledge and contribute to the team's overall expertise.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Liam is of average height, with a lean build and an intense, focused gaze.

quirks: Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when concentrating.
Prefers to work standing up, even when others are seated.
